charge_port.notes: US: J3400 (NACS) DC-only port driver-side rear fender, J1772 AC-only port passenger side; CCS DC adapter standard. Canada release does not state ports (assumed the same).

supercharger_access.notes: Estimated: native NACS DC port; no Porsche page opened states Supercharger access for the Cayenne explicitly (the 2025 programme pages name only Taycan and Macan). Canada Plug & Charge release (Jan 2026) says Cayenne Electric gets Plug & Charge on arrival.

wheels.notes: Cayenne S Electric (CA/US): Cayenne S Electric (SUV): standard 21-inch Aero Design wheels.
Cayenne S Electric (CA/US): Cayenne S Electric (SUV): 20-inch Cayenne S Aero wheel at no extra cost.
